title: The sepsis trial landscape: a domain-specific systematic review and meta-analysis of adult sepsis randomized controlled trials.
why_selected: Selected from this week's highest-ranked ICU evidence. It is a Meta-Analysis, prioritized by evidence level and citation impact.
discussion_prompts: What is the main clinical question and does the study design answer it well?
